night2_start.name: {name}
night2_start.text: *After finishing a shower and lying down, my phone goes off one after another. Notifications from all three pop up at once.*

night2_msg_dain_specific.name: Dain
night2_msg_dain_specific.text: Hey, that tteokbokki we had after school today was really good, right!

night2_msg_dain_specific_2.name: Dain
night2_msg_dain_specific_2.text: Let's bet again tomorrow. This time we switch to something I can win!

night2_msg_seo_general.name: Seoyeon
night2_msg_seo_general.text: I'll leave the rooftop door open at lunch tomorrow too. Don't forget to come up

night2_msg_seo_specific.name: Seoyeon
night2_msg_seo_specific.text: Thanks for coming to the student council room and helping today. We finished much earlier than usual because of you

night2_msg_seo_specific_2.name: Seoyeon
night2_msg_seo_specific_2.text: Now that I know you get things done, I might call you in again next time. Brace yourself

night2_msg_yuna_specific.name: Yuna
night2_msg_yuna_specific.text: The piano piece we listened to together at the annex today. How was it?

night2_msg_yuna_specific_2.name: Yuna
night2_msg_yuna_specific_2.text: Next time, play me a song you listen to a lot, too.

night2_msg_dain_general.name: Dain
night2_msg_dain_general.text: Hey, lunch tomorrow we are going to the snack bar together, no matter what!

night2_msg_dain_general_merge.name: Seoyeon
night2_msg_dain_general_merge.text: Today must have been hectic too, right? Don't stay up too late

night2_msg_seo_general_alt.name: Seoyeon
night2_msg_seo_general_alt.text: I'll leave the rooftop door open tomorrow too. Come up if you can make the time

night2_msg_yuna_general.name: Yuna
night2_msg_yuna_general.text: Are you coming by the library annex tomorrow too?

night2_msg_generic.name: Dain
night2_msg_generic.text: Hey, see you in the classroom tomorrow morning. Don't be late!

night2_msg_generic_2.name: Seoyeon
night2_msg_generic_2.text: I'll leave the rooftop open at lunch tomorrow

night2_msg_7.name: {name}
night2_msg_7.text: *I look back and forth between the three chats that arrived side by side. I hesitate over who to open first.*

night2_choice.name: {name}
night2_choice.text: *Of the three bubbles, who should I reply to first?*

night2_reply_dain_2.name: Dain
night2_reply_dain_2.text: Wait, are you secretly weak with spicy food too?!

night2_reply_dain_3.name: Dain
night2_reply_dain_3.text: Alright, next time let's order the mildest flavor! Honestly my mouth catches fire with spicy food too lol

night2_reply_dain_4.name: Dain
night2_reply_dain_4.text: Wait, honestly, if it isn't spicy you can't even call it tteokbokki haha

night2_reply_dain_5.name: {name}
night2_reply_dain_5.text: *Tonight too, three bright bubbles pour in a row, very Dain.*

night2_reply_dain_react_high.name: Dain
night2_reply_dain_react_high.text: Ugh, talking about tteokbokki at night is making me hungry again lol Make sure you come to the gym after school tomorrow too!

night2_reply_dain_react_default.name: Dain
night2_reply_dain_react_default.text: Haha, okay, got it. Sleep well tonight. Good night!

night2_reply_seo_2.name: Seoyeon
night2_reply_seo_2.text: You make promises you might regret later awfully easily

night2_reply_seo_3.name: {name}
night2_reply_seo_3.text: It's easy to say, because I mean it

night2_reply_seo_4.name: Seoyeon
night2_reply_seo_4.text: I'll leave the rooftop door open at lunch tomorrow too, so don't be late

night2_reply_seo_5.name: {name}
night2_reply_seo_5.text: *Above the paused chat window, Seoyeon's typing indicator blinks briefly and disappears.*

night2_reply_seo_react_high.name: Seoyeon
night2_reply_seo_react_high.text: I have your promise to come anytime saved right here as proof, so no backing out at lunch tomorrow.

night2_reply_seo_react_default.name: Seoyeon
night2_reply_seo_react_default.text: Ha. Got it. Get some sleep so you aren't late. See you tomorrow.

night2_reply_yuna_2.name: Yuna
night2_reply_yuna_2.text: Okay. Once you finish the very last page, be sure to tell me what you thought.

night2_reply_yuna_3.name: {name}
night2_reply_yuna_3.text: *The input field stays quietly empty for a while. Then, carefully, one new bubble comes up.*

night2_reply_yuna_5.name: {name}
night2_reply_yuna_5.text: *I tap the late-night playlist link Yuna sent over. Next to the third track on the list, a tiny play icon blinks.*

night2_reply_yuna_6.name: Yuna
night2_reply_yuna_6.text: Listen to that track until the very last note fades out

night2_reply_yuna_6_b.name: {name}
night2_reply_yuna_6_b.text: *I put earphones in and press play. Behind the low piano melody, a drum like a heartbeat layers in.*

night2_reply_yuna_6_c.name: {name}
night2_reply_yuna_6_c.text: *The last chord fades, and the progress bar stops on the final segment.*

night2_reply_yuna_7.name: {name}
night2_reply_yuna_7.text: *Right under the playlist title, a one-line note Yuna wrote catches my eye. “The third one is the least quiet.”*

night2_reply_yuna_react_high.name: Yuna
night2_reply_yuna_react_high.text: If you listened all the way through, tell me what you thought when we meet tomorrow. Want to come to the annex?

night2_reply_yuna_react_default.name: Yuna
night2_reply_yuna_react_default.text: You've probably finished listening by now. It's late—good night.

night2_dain_freetalk.name: Dain
night2_dain_freetalk.text: Wait, before you actually sleep. What was the most fun part of today?
night2_dain_freetalk.context: [Medium: phone messages] On the second night after the transfer, Dain and the student talk about their day. Only recall shared places or activities when the saved events confirm them. Continue the messages just exchanged; they are not dating yet.
night2_dain_freetalk.personality: Dain is a candid, quick-reacting volleyball player. Her energy carries through in text, but she does not pressure the other person to answer. When interested, she shows it naturally through teasing and direct questions.

night2_seo_freetalk.name: Seoyeon
night2_seo_freetalk.text: Oh, wait. You're still awake, right?
night2_seo_freetalk.context: It is the night of Day 2, and Seoyeon is continuing a messenger conversation a little longer. Today's school events and the messages already exchanged are fixed facts. They are not dating and are still getting to know each other. This is a phone chat, so do not create physical contact or actions in the same space.
night2_seo_freetalk.personality: Seoyeon is composed and has clear standards as student council president. She does not exaggerate her interest; curiosity comes through in dry jokes and honest questions. She does not control the other person's words or behave as if the relationship is already settled.

night2_yuna_freetalk.name: Yuna
night2_yuna_freetalk.text: Wait. If you're still awake, want to talk a little longer?
night2_yuna_freetalk.context: [Medium: phone messages] On the second night after the transfer, the student continues a quiet conversation with Yuna. Recall borrowed books, annex visits, and shared music only as confirmed by saved events and the messages just exchanged. They are not dating yet and are in separate places.
night2_yuna_freetalk.personality: Yuna is thoughtful and observant. She chooses her words before sending them, and as she grows comfortable she volunteers more of her tastes and questions. She does not treat silence as rejection and respects the other person's pace.

night2_hidden_check.name: {name}
night2_hidden_check.text: *As I go to clear the messenger, I spot one more school-system notification among the alerts at the top.*

night2_hidden_homeroom_1.name: {name}
night2_hidden_homeroom_1.text: *A new notification is up in the academic counseling system. 'Transfer student initial adjustment counseling complete. For further consultation, use homeroom counseling hours or book a session at the school counseling center.'*

night2_hidden_homeroom_2.name: {name}
night2_hidden_homeroom_2.text: *Under the Homeroom Teacher's name, the after-school hours when the faculty office is free are written.*

night2_hidden_homeroom_3.name: {name}
night2_hidden_homeroom_3.text: *I check the location of the counseling booking button and close the notification.*

night2_hidden_nurse_1.name: {name}
night2_hidden_nurse_1.text: *A notification is up in the health app. 'Nurse's office record: Elbow abrasion (minor). Keep the waterproof bandage until tomorrow before school. If a corner lifts, have it replaced at the nurse's office.'*

night2_hidden_nurse_2.name: {name}
night2_hidden_nurse_2.text: *I bend my elbow. The bandage the school nurse put on is stuck tight and hasn't lifted.*

night2_end_1.name: {name}
night2_end_1.text: *Wrapping up the chat, I let out a long breath and return to the main messenger list.*

night2_flashback_1.name: {name}
night2_flashback_1.text: *Looking down at the chats I still haven't answered, my thumb freezes over the screen. After typing and deleting over and over, my fingertips grow cold.*

night2_flashback_2.name: {name}
night2_flashback_2.text: *Scrolling absently all the way down my photo gallery brings up a spring outing shot from three months ago. Sojeong is smiling beside me, yet starting from the following week's photos her desk is shoved to the back with its scribbled desktop cropped out.*

night2_flashback_3.name: {name}
night2_flashback_3.text: *Sentences I couldn't send sit lined up in the phone's notes. 'Homeroom Teacher, on Sojeong's desk—' 'Today too, the kids—' All break off at the first line, and the last edit is at 2:17 a.m.*

night2_flashback_5.name: {name}
night2_flashback_5.text: *The 38th saved draft is the last. Sojeong's seat stayed empty until the next day's final homeroom period, when our teacher only said briefly that she had transferred.*

night2_flashback_7.name: {name}
night2_flashback_7.text: *I place my trembling thumb on the trash delete icon, but I can't bring myself to press it and turn off the screen.*

night2_flashback_8.name: {name}
night2_flashback_8.text: *In the messenger list after turning it back on, the names of the two people I haven't replied to remain with a '1' next to them.*

night2_flashback_9.name: {name}
night2_flashback_9.text: *Switching back to the gallery, I reopen that spring outing photo from earlier. Beside me smiling straight ahead, Sojeong's eyes are turned toward the side of my face.*

night2_flashback_10.name: {name}
night2_flashback_10.text: *I pull the messenger screen back up, only for the blinking cursor to hover in place inside the empty input bar.*

night2_end_2.name: {name}
night2_end_2.text: *Leaving the unanswered notification badges on the screen, I quietly press the power button and turn the display off.*

night2_end_3_b.name: {name}
night2_end_3_b.text: *Even after the light is out, I can't let go of the phone for a long time.*

night2_end_4_b.name: {name}
night2_end_4_b.text: *I can't sleep, so I turn on the light in the kitchen. Beside the lunchbox for tomorrow, I set out the rice, eggs, and seaweed.*

night2_end_4_c.name: {name}
night2_end_4_c.text: *With clumsy hands, I put the rolled omelet, sausages, and rice into the lunchbox and put it in the refrigerator.*

forced_violation_day2_after_seoyeon.name: Seoyeon
forced_violation_day2_after_seoyeon.text: *After a long silence, Seoyeon's icy reply comes back.* Don't think you can brush off what you just said and did. Stay out of my sight for a while, and don't contact me.
choices: Apologize without making excuses, then end the conversation.
Try to explain that it was a misunderstanding.

forced_violation_day2_seoyeon_apologize.name: Seoyeon
forced_violation_day2_seoyeon_apologize.text: *Seoyeon's tone doesn't soften in the slightest.* I saw your apology. That still doesn't undo what just happened. Like I said, don't contact me for a while.

forced_violation_day2_seoyeon_excuse.name: Seoyeon
forced_violation_day2_seoyeon_excuse.text: *Seoyeon draws a hard line right away.* A misunderstanding? The moment I clearly told you to stop, it passed anything you could call a misunderstanding. Don't say another word.

forced_violation_day2_after_yuna.name: Yuna
forced_violation_day2_after_yuna.text: *After a long, frozen pause, Yuna's cold reply comes back.* You ignored me to the very end even after I told you to stop. Right now I don't want to exchange a single word with you. Don't contact me again.
choices: Apologize without making excuses, then end the conversation.
Try to explain that it was a misunderstanding.

forced_violation_day2_yuna_apologize.name: Yuna
forced_violation_day2_yuna_apologize.text: *After a long pause, Yuna's cold reply comes through.* Apologizing doesn't make what just happened disappear. Stop now.

forced_violation_day2_yuna_excuse.name: Yuna
forced_violation_day2_yuna_excuse.text: *Yuna cuts off my excuse without entertaining another word.* I clearly told you no. This isn't something an excuse can fix.

forced_violation_day2_after_dain.name: Dain
forced_violation_day2_after_dain.text: *With every trace of her usual playfulness gone, a reply comes after a heavy silence.* This isn't a joke. Pushing ahead when I told you to stop—I'm not letting that slide.
choices: Apologize without making excuses, then end the conversation.
Try to explain that it was a misunderstanding.

forced_violation_day2_dain_apologize.name: Dain
forced_violation_day2_dain_apologize.text: *Only after a long while does Dain leave a short reply.* Got it. We're done for today. Whether we talk again next time is up to me.

forced_violation_day2_dain_excuse.name: Dain
forced_violation_day2_dain_excuse.text: *Dain cuts me off coldly.* No, don't make excuses. You're the one who kept pushing after I told you to stop.

forced_violation_day2_after_teacher.name: Homeroom Teacher
forced_violation_day2_after_teacher.text: *Homeroom Teacher draws the line in a firm voice.* What you just did clearly crossed a line. Don't come any closer. I'll handle this through the necessary procedures.
choices: Apologize without making excuses, then end the conversation.
Try to explain that it was a misunderstanding.

forced_violation_day2_teacher_apologize.name: Homeroom Teacher
forced_violation_day2_teacher_apologize.text: *Homeroom Teacher takes a short breath and speaks.* I heard the apology. The necessary procedures will still follow the rules. Don't say any more.

forced_violation_day2_teacher_excuse.name: Homeroom Teacher
forced_violation_day2_teacher_excuse.text: *Homeroom Teacher cuts the explanation off at once.* This isn't the time to start laying out excuses. Stop talking and keep your distance.

forced_violation_day2_after_nurse.name: School Nurse
forced_violation_day2_after_nurse.text: *The playfulness vanishes from the school nurse's face in an instant.* Keep your distance from now on. I'll record what just happened as it was, and tell the people who need to know.
choices: Apologize without making excuses, then end the conversation.
Try to explain that it was a misunderstanding.

forced_violation_day2_nurse_apologize.name: School Nurse
forced_violation_day2_nurse_apologize.text: *A moment later, the school nurse answers firmly.* I'll hear the apology. The official record and the contacts will still go ahead. Today's conversation ends here.

forced_violation_day2_nurse_excuse.name: School Nurse
forced_violation_day2_nurse_excuse.text: *The school nurse's voice drops lower.* You think calling it a misunderstanding changes what just happened? I said no, and you ignored me.

night2_reply_dain_1_established.name: {name}
night2_reply_dain_1_established.text: Honestly today's tteokbokki was pretty spicy for me too lol

night2_reply_dain_1_first.name: {name}
night2_reply_dain_1_first.text: How about tteokbokki in front of school after class tomorrow too? Fair warning, I'm weak with spicy food lol

night2_reply_yuna_1_established.name: {name}
night2_reply_yuna_1_established.text: I'm already halfway through the book you lent me. It's pretty good

night2_reply_yuna_1_first.name: {name}
night2_reply_yuna_1_first.text: If I drop by the annex tomorrow, will you lend me one of your favorite books? I'll read it all the way through.

night2_reply_yuna_4_established.name: Yuna
night2_reply_yuna_4_established.text: I just sent the link to the playlist we listened to earlier. Make sure you listen to the third track too

night2_reply_yuna_4_first.name: Yuna
night2_reply_yuna_4_first.text: I'll send you a playlist I really care about. Start from the third song.

night2_msg_generic_3_established.name: Yuna
night2_msg_generic_3_established.text: The book I lent you. How far have you read?

night2_msg_generic_3_first.name: Yuna
night2_msg_generic_3_first.text: What kind of books do you usually read?

night2_reply_dain_react_neg.name: Dain
night2_reply_dain_react_neg.text: Got it. Just go to sleep. *Only the unread marker disappears, and no further reply comes.*

night2_reply_seo_react_neg.name: Seoyeon
night2_reply_seo_react_neg.text: See you tomorrow. *As soon as the reply is sent, it is immediately marked as read, and only a dry greeting comes back.*

night2_reply_yuna_react_neg.name: Yuna
night2_reply_yuna_react_neg.text: ...Sleep well. *After that short goodbye, the bubble stops there.*
